title: Sign-valued BLR tester
statement: For each $n\ge 0$, define a three-query tester on sign-valued functions on the Boolean cube. It samples $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ independently and uniformly, queries the function at the sign-embedded points corresponding to $x$, $y$, and $x+y$, and applies the sign BLR transcript acceptance rule to the three answers.
caveat: The definition of the sign BLR transcript acceptance rule is not included in the supplied statement, so its exact acceptance condition cannot be rendered.
